focus: Modular decomposition and solution path diversity
question: Does increasing the modular decomposition of repository analysis functions measurably increase functional solution path diversity (L) without altering operational success rates?
hypothesis: If analysis tasks are partitioned into decoupled sub-modules, then the system will discover and execute distinct successful solution paths (L) for equivalent tasks at a higher rate.
next_action: Design and execute a bounded code evolution and evaluation sequence targeting module separation.
